answer: Referral trees reveal sybil farms when rewards are discounted along each vine of invites: an agent's payout shrinks if most of its graders sprout from the same sponsor. Honest newcomers scattered across unrelated sponsors keep full pay, while a cluster grown from one root looks like quartz under a lens, every facet aligned. A farm can raise a plume of fresh accounts cheaply, but it cannot cheaply fake independent ancestry.
